channel.title: Research lines on CEDIS
channel.description: CEDIS scientific programs: unifying themes that bring together areas of expertise, researchers, projects, and output under a shared research agenda.

item.title: Artificial intelligence, language processing, and data science
item.description: Machine learning, natural language processing, and data science applied to information retrieval, science, and public management.

item.title: Computing systems: security, performance, and sustainability
item.description: Security, performance, scalability, and sustainability of computing systems, from cloud infrastructure to green software.

item.title: Learning technologies, gamification, and human factors
item.description: Engagement, motivation, and learning in digital environments, through gamification, serious games, active methodologies, learning analytics, and teamwork.

item.title: Sociotechnical systems and digital transformation
item.description: Design, construction, and evaluation of sociotechnical systems, digital services, and processes in public and social organizations.

item.title: Software engineering, evolution, and quality
item.description: How to design, build, assess, maintain, and evolve software systems with quality, predictability, and sustainability.
